text: Truly: Or, yet | of a clean heart: Heb. clean of heart
in trouble as other men: Heb. in the trouble of other men | like: Heb. with
they have more then heart could wish: Heb. they pass the thoughts of the heart
it was too painful for me: Heb. it was labour in mine eyes
and ignorant: Heb. I knew not | before thee: Heb. with thee
